mentions.name: Pyor
mentions.description: A desktop GitHub client focused on improving the user experience for managing pull requests and reviewing code. It includes Slack integrations and support for connecting AI models (such as Claude and Codex) via API keys or the user's own subscriptions.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently working on a GitHub client that improves the user experience. A desktop app fr managing PRs and reviewing code, with intergations for slack and every AI modal using API Keys or your own subscription like Claude and Codex.
mentions.author: othmanosx

mentions.name: pyor.review
mentions.description: A code review platform that serves as an alternative to GitHub, focused on making the human PR review experience easier and faster.
mentions.problem: The human PR review experience on GitHub is hard and slow.
mentions.source_excerpt:
